# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_VWAP_RECLAIM_REJECTION_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by using VWAP reclaim or rejection as an entry trigger, filtered by volume proximity and ribbon agreement. The edge exists because VWAP acts as dynamic intraday fair value, and reclaims/rejections with confirming volume and EMA ribbon alignment indicate institutional participation with higher probability of continuation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger fires on the first 3-min bar ≤10:30 ET where:  
- Price reclaims VWAP (close > VWAP after prior close ≤ VWAP) OR rejects VWAP (close < VWAP after prior close ≥ VWAP)  
- Bar volume ≥ vol_mult (1.5) × 20-bar average volume  
- Bar close within proximity_dollars ($0.15) of VWAP  
- Minimum body size ≥ body_min_cents ($0.05) to avoid doji-like bars  
- Require EMA ribbon agreement (require_ribbon_agreement=true) with minimum spread ≥ ribbon_min_spread_cents (30.0 cents)  
- Uses lookback_bars (2) to confirm VWAP side prior to trigger bar  

**Exit:**  
- Premium stop at premium_stop_pct (-0.14) → 14% loss on entry premium  
- TP1 at tp1_premium_pct (0.5) → 50% profit target, selling tp1_qty_fraction (0.667) of position  
- Runner target at runner_target_pct (2.0) → 200% profit target for remaining runner  
- Profit lock arms at profit_lock_threshold_pct (0.1) then trails by profit_lock_stop_offset_pct (0.05)  
- Standard chandelier profit-lock and 15:50 ET time stop apply
